society_name: GDG On Campus National Institute of Technology Hamirpur
about: GDG NITH is a student developer community that conducts hands-on workshops, hackathons, and technical study jams focused on modern developer technologies and open-source software. It provides a collaborative environment for students to build real-world projects, learn industry-relevant skills, and connect with peer developers and mentors.
